g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Azure customer portal on App Service with private endpoints

g.title: None.None.Node.26
g.text: The portal's name resolves in Azure DNS to Front Door
Front Door, with its WAF policy, reaches the web app over a Private Link origin; the app has no public access
The web app reads the customer's session from Redis through its private endpoint
It calls the API Function App through the API's private endpoint, from its integration subnet
The API saves the claim to Azure SQL
and queues a document job on Service Bus
The Service Bus trigger starts the worker Function App
The worker writes the claim PDF to Blob Storage through its private endpoint
It emails the customer through the NAT gateway
which calls the email provider from a fixed public IP
